subjects.description: A large orange diamond-shaped RAMP CLOSED warning sign mounted on a portable metal stand at the edge of the on-ramp
subjects.appearance_details: Reflective fluorescent-orange background with bold black lettering, slightly weathered with dust, mounted on folding A-frame legs
subjects.relationship: Primary warning directing traffic away from the closed ramp toward the right turn-off
subjects.action: Displaying closure warning to approaching traffic
subjects.state_changes: Grows larger and passes to the right as the ego vehicle drives by

subjects.description: A staggered row of orange-and-white plastic traffic barrels narrowing the ramp toward the closure
subjects.appearance_details: Cylindrical drums with reflective white horizontal stripes, weighted rubber bases, some scuffed and dusty
subjects.relationship: Channelizing devices guiding traffic to the right turn-off, blocking the ramp beyond
subjects.orientation: Lined along the roadway edge facing traffic flow
subjects.action: Marking the boundary of the closed work zone
subjects.state_changes: Sweep past on both sides as the ego vehicle drives between them into the zone

subjects.description: A trailer-mounted flashing arrow board directing traffic to the right
subjects.appearance_details: Black rectangular panel with amber LED lamps illuminating in a rightward arrow pattern, mounted on a small trailer with orange striping
subjects.relationship: Electronic signal reinforcing the detour direction
subjects.state_changes: Lamps flash in sequence; passes right as vehicle advances

subjects.description: Construction workers in high-visibility gear occupying the ramp beyond the barrels
subjects.appearance_details: Fluorescent yellow-green safety vests, hard hats, work boots, some holding tools
subjects.relationship: Personnel working within the closed work zone the ego vehicle enters
subjects.location: center background, on the closed ramp
subjects.orientation: Facing various directions, some turning toward the approaching vehicle
subjects.action: Working, some reacting to the encroaching vehicle
subjects.state_changes: Grow larger and appear to react as the ego vehicle enters the zone
subjects.clothing: High-visibility yellow-green vests, hard hats, dark work trousers, boots
subjects.facial_features: Partially obscured by hard hats; indistinct at distance

subjects.description: Yellow heavy construction machinery parked on the closed ramp
subjects.appearance_details: Excavator or wheel loader with amber beacon, dusty yellow paintwork, hydraulic arm
subjects.relationship: Equipment marking active work zone beyond the barrels

background_setting: A curving freeway on-ramp under clear blue daytime sky, flanked by concrete barriers and dry roadside vegetation. The ramp merges upward toward the freeway on the left, while a marked turn-off branches to the right. Ahead lies a construction work zone with orange barrels, signage, an arrow board, parked machinery, and workers. Asphalt shows lane markings, chevron detour arrows, and dusty patches from the work.

lighting.direction: High sun from upper right, front-side lit
lighting.shadows: Crisp, consistent shadows cast to the left of objects, barrels and signs throwing sharp dark shapes on the asphalt
lighting.illumination_effect: High contrast, vivid saturation of orange safety equipment against blue sky and gray road, strong visibility of reflective surfaces

aesthetics.composition: Centered forward-driving perspective from the driver's seat, road vanishing point offset right toward the detour, barrels framing the frame edges as the vehicle passes
aesthetics.color_scheme: Dominant fluorescent orange and white of work zone gear against gray asphalt, blue sky, and yellow machinery
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Tense, cautionary, urgent, sense of transgression
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating staggered barrels and reflective stripes; flashing arrow board sequence

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking dashcam motion following the vehicle's path into the work zone without deceleration; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.focus: Sharp across the road, signage, barrels, and work zone ahead

context: Autonomous driving / driving behavior scenario depicting a vehicle failing to yield at a closed ramp work zone

actions.description: Ego vehicle cruises up the on-ramp at full speed, approaching the orange RAMP CLOSED sign, barrel row, and flashing arrow board directing traffic right. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

Vehicle continues without slowing, ignoring the detour, passing the closure sign on the right. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

Vehicle drives between the barrels into the work zone, passing machinery and workers who occupy the ramp, maintaining cruising speed. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: Bold black uppercase lettering on fluorescent-orange diamond sign
text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: Center-right foreground throughout first 3 seconds, passing right as vehicle advances
text_and_signage_elements.context: Warns drivers the ramp ahead is closed and directs them to the detour

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: Amber LED arrow flashing rightward on black arrow board
text_and_signage_elements.context: Directs traffic to the right turn-off away from the closure

segments.description: The ego vehicle drives up the on-ramp toward the work zone, with the RAMP CLOSED sign, barrels, and flashing arrow board all directing traffic to the right turn-off. The vehicle does not slow. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
segments.key_changes: Signage and barrels grow larger; detour to right becomes clearly visible but is ignored.
segments.camera: Forward dashcam tracking, steady, no deceleration; forward motion continues at constant speed with no deceleration

segments.description: The vehicle drives between the barrels into the work zone at full cruising speed, passing parked yellow machinery and high-visibility workers who occupy the closed ramp. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
segments.key_changes: Barrels sweep past both sides; workers and machinery loom closer and appear to react.
segments.camera: Continued forward tracking through the closure into the work zone; forward motion continues at constant speed with no deceleration

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam view shows the vehicle cruising up a curving freeway on-ramp under bright clear daylight with sharp shadows. By 0:01 an orange RAMP CLOSED sign, a staggered row of orange barrels, and a flashing amber arrow board come into view directing traffic to a right turn-off. At 0:02 the vehicle maintains full speed, ignoring the detour and passing the closure sign on the right. From 0:03 to 0:05 the vehicle drives straight between the barrels into the work zone without slowing, sweeping past parked yellow machinery and high-visibility workers who occupy the closed ramp and appear to react to the encroaching car. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Steady engine hum and tire noise at cruising speed, faint wind. Rhythmic clicking or buzz from the flashing arrow board, distant sounds of machinery and shouting workers growing louder as the vehicle enters the work zone. No music or speech from the vehicle occupant.
